name: Latin Pachucos
description: The Latin Pachucos are a People Nation street gang founded circa 1983 in the West Humboldt Park neighborhood of Chicago, notable for being a Mexican gang that emerged in a predominantly Puerto Rican and Black area. They are active in neighborhoods including Belmont-Cragin and expanded into the suburb of Cicero around 1996–1997.
